Palm Fete (Miami, Fla.)
fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical local commentary tied to Miami’s Palm Fete and visiting editors, with discussion of tourism and celebrity visits (including Gene Tunney), local business promotion and advertising, transportation and policing anecdotes, and coverage of harbor and dock matters affecting Miami and nearby communities. It also contains prohibition-era commentary and warnings about counterfeit liquor, along with society notes, entertainment listings, and extensive local advertising.
